x402.settlement: USDC; Base or Solana mainnet per provider documentation

observations.observation: The same You.com Web Search service is publicly listed at US$0.005 via x402 and US$0.01 via MPP. Provider documentation attributes the difference to the payment rail's minimum charge. This is observed listed-price evidence only, not a live quote or paid result.
observations.benchmarkImplication: Outcome economics must bind provider outcome evidence to payment rail. Otherwise a provider ranking can silently confound supplier quality with rail-specific transaction economics. The current benchmark remains x402-only; cross-rail comparison is out of scope until the locked x402 task benchmark has paid evidence.

rules: Do not merge listed prices from different payment rails into one provider price.
Do not treat alternative-rail catalogue pricing as an x402 live quote.
Do not include alternative-rail observations in paid outcome economics without an observed paid execution on that rail.
Keep structured-web-search x402 as the locked primary benchmark until kill criteria are hit.
